'''Kiantryl Liawoon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:KiantrylLiawoon.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depiction of Kiantryl Liawoon]]
Kiantryl Liawoon was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].

Although Liawoon consistently spawned as a female Selonian, her appearance was randomized between one of thirty possible depictions.
